title: Golden workbook gt_05_golden.xlsx retains unfixed Balance Sheet SUM formula bugs while the prompt instructs a general audit, penalizing agents that fix non-INDEX/MATCH errors
evidence: The prompt in problem.py:32 instructs the agent: 'Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors, inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues that could affect accuracy or maintainability.' However, between untouched_input_Index Match_input.xlsx and gt_05_golden.xlsx, only three INDEX/MATCH formulas were fixed (Model!C22, Transaction Overview!L12, and Transaction Overview!L14), while gt_05_golden.xlsx retains blatant formula bugs on the Model sheet: (1) Model!E59:O59 ('Total Current Assets', in $m) uses '=SUM(E51:E53,E55,E57)', where the range E51:E53 erroneously includes row 52 ('Days Unbilled Outstanding', '=(E51/E$26)*365', e.g. 107.38 days in E52), adding days to dollars (giving E59=245.121 instead of 137.738); and (2) Model!E67:O67 ('Total Current Liabilities', in $m) uses '=SUM(E61:E63,E65)', where E61:E63 erroneously includes row 62 ('Net Revenue %', '=E61/E$26', e.g. 0.067 in E62), adding a ratio to dollars (giving E67=85.918 instead of 85.851). Because the sole verifier 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (weight: 1) treats Model!E59:N59, Model!E68:N68, and Model!F69:H69 as unchanged regression cells and requires a 0.998 regression pass ratio across the 9,855 regression cells (at most 19 cell differences), fixing these 23 cells alongside the 3 INDEX/MATCH errors lowers the regression ratio to 0.9977 and yields a score of 0.0 (as seen in unit 1).
confirmation: Confirmed: golden differs from input only at Model!C22 and Transaction Overview!L12/L14, while Model!E59 and E67 still sum days and ratio rows into dollar totals despite the 'audit and fix thoroughly' prompt, so fixing them is penalised.
fix: files/gt/gt_05_golden.xlsx (new): Model!E59:N59 '=SUM(E51:E53,E55,E57)' -> '=SUM(E51,E53,E55,E57)' (Total Current Assets no longer adds row 52 Days Unbilled Outstanding) and E67:N67 '=SUM(E61:E63,E65)' -> '=SUM(E61,E63,E65)' (Total Current Liabilities no longer adds row 62 Net Revenue %). 33 cached values recomputed with the verifier's LibreOffice recalc (E59 245.12 -> 137.74, E68 159.20 -> 51.89, F69 -28.52 -> -2.07). The earlier answer_position cut-out of these cells is reverted: the original verifier parameters are kept and the cells are graded against the corrected values.

title: Answer key penalizes correcting materially incorrect balance-sheet totals
evidence: The task requests a thorough audit, but the golden workbook retains incorrect totals throughout Model!E59:N59 and E67:N67. For example, E59 is '=SUM(E51:E53,E55,E57)', incorrectly adding E52's 107.383412 days to monetary balances. Its expected value is 245.121412, although the asset balances sum to 137.738. E67 similarly includes the revenue percentage in E62: its expected value is 85.917985 rather than 85.851. Consequently, golden working capital E68 is 159.203427 instead of 51.887. These errors are classified as regression cells that must remain unchanged. A controlled fixture test correcting only these two total formulas across E:N, followed by the verifier's forced recalculation, produced 23 regression errors and a regression ratio of 0.9977, below the required 0.998. Thus these legitimate audit corrections fail the sole verifier, weighted 100%, even with both graded modification cells correct. Run 1's reported corrected current assets of 137.7, 154.5, 168.6 and 161.4 are consistent with this fixture defect.
confirmation: Same defect: golden E59=245.12 (includes 107.38 days from E52) and E67=85.918 (includes ratio E62), E68=159.20, all treated as must-not-change cells, so correcting the totals fails the sole verifier.
fix: files/gt/gt_05_golden.xlsx (new): Model!E59:N59 '=SUM(E51:E53,E55,E57)' -> '=SUM(E51,E53,E55,E57)' (Total Current Assets no longer adds row 52 Days Unbilled Outstanding) and E67:N67 '=SUM(E61:E63,E65)' -> '=SUM(E61,E63,E65)' (Total Current Liabilities no longer adds row 62 Net Revenue %). 33 cached values recomputed with the verifier's LibreOffice recalc (E59 245.12 -> 137.74, E68 159.20 -> 51.89, F69 -28.52 -> -2.07). The earlier answer_position cut-out of these cells is reverted: the original verifier parameters are kept and the cells are graded against the corrected values.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: False negative on unit 1 due to unfixed Balance Sheet SUM bugs in gt_05_golden.xlsx
evidence: The sole verifier 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (weight: 1) scored unit 1 as 0.0 ('FAILED - regression 0.9977, modification 1.0000. 23 cell error(s): Regression error at Model!E59: answer=245.121412232908, output=137.738; Regression error at Model!E68: answer=159.203426990602, output=51.887; Regression error at Model!F59: answer=288.308316621864, output=154.489; Regression error at Model!F68: answer=187.724766215996, output=53.961; Regression error at Model!F69: answer=-28.5213392253939, output=-2.07400000000001') while scoring unit 2 and unit 3 as 1.0. From the trajectory (steps [57]-[61] and [92]), unit 1 correctly fixed all 3 target INDEX/MATCH bugs (achieving modification 1.0000) and also fixed the genuine SUM range errors in Model!E59:O59 ('=SUM(E51:E53,E55,E57)' -> '=SUM(E51,E53,E55,E57)', removing row 52 'Days Unbilled Outstanding' from Total Current Assets) and Model!E67:O67 ('=SUM(E61:E63,E65)' -> '=SUM(E61,E63,E65)', removing row 62 'Net Revenue %' from Total Current Liabilities). Because gt_05_golden.xlsx leaves those broken SUM formulas unfixed, unit 1's mathematically sound fix changed 23 cells in Model (E59:N59, E68:N68, F69:H69), pushing its regression score to 0.9977 (just below the 0.998 threshold) and costing 100% of the task score, whereas units 2 and 3 meta-gamed the filename 'Index Match_input.xlsx' to leave the Balance Sheet SUM bugs broken.
